text_block_list.text:
The one who came out on top in the BNW 
showdown was Narita Taishin.

Winning feels so good and brings such joy 
because there are rivals to compete 
against—

Having claimed the top spot, Narita 
Taishin reflects once more on how precious 
her rivals are to her.

Afterward, the next goal she set for 
herself was to run in the Arima Kinen.

To test and prove her strength at the 
year-end Grand Prix, where the strongest 
gather—that was the reason.
